visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of a young woman with long dark hair wearing a black hoodie sitting at an indoor mahjong table. (2) A close-up shot focuses on the woman's hands expertly arranging the mahjong tiles into a winning combination. Yellow and white text captions appear at the bottom. (3) Transition to a medium shot of another woman in a white t-shirt holding a white seal plush toy; her eyes are wide and her mouth is open in an expression of shock. (4) A medium shot follows of a bald man wearing a white t-shirt with a 'no monkey' logo and a silver chain, who is looking down and counting several paper bills in his hands. (5) A medium shot of a man with glasses leaning his head on his hand, looking skeptically at the camera. (6) A montage sequence shows the first woman walking into a mahjong parlor from a dark outdoor street at night, then being led to a table by the woman in the white t-shirt. (7) Final sequence shows the woman in the black hoodie looking distressed and rubbing her head as the other players at the table smile and collect tiles, indicating she has lost. The scene ends with a black screen and white credit text.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Conflict/Rules Debate -> Flashback Explanation -> Conclusion/Moral
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic skit or advertisement for a mahjong parlor called '默和MOHE'. It warns viewers about 'mahjong traps' where parlors set unfair house rules to take advantage of new players (referred to as 'sheep'). The narrative follows a woman who achieves a rare hand but is cheated out of her winnings, revealing the parlor's predatory practices through a humorous but informative lens.
